note: Curated by Claude from the current state of the project. Seeded before live traffic/download/social numbers are flowing — these sharpen once GA4 + ASC are connected and the first Instagram insights run lands.

items.title: Connect GA4 → light up Traffic + 'articles that landed customers'
items.why: Traffic and the conversion bridge are dark until GA4 is wired. The hard part is already done — site.js fires app_store_click / outbound_click per page, so once GA4 reads, you get true article→install attribution.
steps: Create a GA4 service account with the Analytics Data API enabled; grant it Viewer on the property
Add GA4_PROPERTY_ID + GA4_SA_JSON to Vercel env vars
Ping me — I'll build api/ga4.js and wire the Traffic + attribution panels

items.title: Connect App Store Connect → light up Downloads
items.why: Installs/conversion is the top-of-funnel number with no live source yet. You have ASC, so it's just an API key away.
steps: App Store Connect → Users and Access → Integrations → create an API key (.p8), note the Issuer ID + Key ID
Add ASC_ISSUER_ID, ASC_KEY_ID, ASC_P8 to Vercel env vars
Ping me — I'll build api/asc.js and wire the Downloads panel

items.title: Baseline the socials — run the insights button
items.why: Nothing to analyze until the first pull lands. Establish a baseline now, then re-run weekly to watch trends.
steps: Hit 'Refresh Instagram numbers' on this dashboard
Re-run weekly (Mondays) to track follower + reach growth

items.title: Validate the text hooks against the 79% skip rate
items.why: The whole hook rollout (days 8–46) targets reel retention. Needs ~5 hooked reels live to read a signal.
steps: After ~5 hooked reels have posted (~late June), compare avg watch time: hooked (🪝) vs non-hooked reels in the insights
If watch time is up → keep and expand hooks to all reels
If flat → iterate the hook copy on the weakest performers and re-test

items.title: Keep the content queues from drying up
items.why: The phone drip and the daily IG posts both feed off the article pipeline. Field Guide burns faster (publishes ~5/wk vs Understory ~3/wk).
steps: Watch the Ops 'runway' tile below — it flags when a section drops under ~2 weeks
Top up leaf_queue / guide_queue before either hits the warning band

items.title: Ship the new App Store description on the next app update
items.why: The promo text (differentiation hook) is already live, but the fuller description rides the next version submission.
steps: Paste the drafted 'generic apps can't ID the good stuff' description into the next version's App Store listing

items.title: Confirm the iOS→web entitlement bridge is deployed
items.why: Code is fully built; only runtime config (Firebase function deploy + RevenueCat webhook) is unverified. Low impact since customers live in the app, but worth closing.
steps: Confirm the Firebase revenuecatWebhook function is deployed and the RevenueCat dashboard webhook points at it
Sandbox-purchase on a signed-in account → check that user's Firebase 'subscriber' custom claim flips true
